description: Free, no payment: bytecode-only preview of a deployed smart contract. Covers proxy/upgradeability, ERC-20 probe (name, symbol, owner, paused), risky selectors found in the bytecode (mint, blacklist, fee/tax setters, pause, upgrade), SELFDESTRUCT/DELEGATECALL opcodes, and a partialScore/partialLevel computed from those on-chain signals only. Does NOT cover source verification (Blockscout, Sourcify) nor aderyn static analysis, so partialScore can be lower than the real risk. contract_risk_summary ($0.02 in USDC via x402) is the full report. Read-only, no side effects; an EOA is rejected; identical requests within 10 minutes return the cached result; the HTTP twin GET /v1/flags/:chainId/:address is rate limited to 30 requests per minute per IP.
